name: Firebase Performance Monitoring

dataTypes.when: Always: app performance metrics (app start time, network request latency), CPU/memory usage and relevant device metadata. Also custom traces, metrics and attributes if the developer instruments them.
Always: the IP address is collected to map performance events to the countries they originate from.

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always: Firebase installation ID (FID), a per-installation identifier, collected by the transitively included Firebase installations SDK (com.google.firebase:firebase-installations).

ask: Do you add custom traces or custom attributes (putAttribute)? If attributes contain personal data (user IDs, emails, locations), declare those data types.
Performance Monitoring transitively includes Firebase Remote Config and Firebase sessions. Make sure the firebase-config entry is also declared.

sources.title: Prepare for Google Play's data disclosure requirements (Firebase)

notes: Approximate location is our mapping of 'IP address ... to map performance events to the countries they originate from' (Play has no IP-address data type; IP used to derive location is usually declared as Approximate location). Depends on firebase-installations, firebase-config and firebase-sessions. Firebase's page does not give a per-product collected/shared table; it states globally that Firebase does not transfer the listed data to third parties except to subprocessors that help provide Firebase services or per the developer's instructions (e.g. linking to non-Firebase services). On that basis shared=false and role=service-provider. The page lists raw data items (e.g. 'stack traces', 'IP address'), not Play data-type labels; the mapping to Play labels and purposes here is ours.
